name: TRID
description: Regulates disclosure of loan terms and closing costs via Loan Estimate and Closing Disclosure.

name: RESPA
description: Governs settlement services and prohibits kickbacks, referral fees, and unearned fees.

name: ECOA
description: Prohibits discrimination against credit applicants on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, marital status, or age.

name: Reg X
description: Procedural rules a servicer must follow on a loss-mitigation application — 5-day acknowledgment, 30-day evaluation of a complete application, denial / appeal notices (14 days), and the dual-tracking guard that bars a foreclosure sale while a complete application is pending. Enforced live in the LM Eligibility journey (see server/agent/regx-logic.ts).

name: Fannie Mae
fullName: Fannie Mae Servicing Guide — Loss Mitigation
description: GSE servicing requirements for Fannie Mae-owned loans: the retention waterfall (Forbearance → Payment Deferral → Flex Modification — Trial), Form 710 (Mortgage Assistance Application) intake matrices, the Flex Modification calculation (D2-3.2-06 / F-1-27: ~20% P&I reduction target, up to 480-month term, principal forbearance to bring MTM LTV to ≤80%). Encoded in LM_THRESHOLDS in loss-mit-logic.ts.

name: Freddie Mac
fullName: Freddie Mac Servicing Guide — Loss Mitigation
description: GSE servicing requirements for Freddie Mac-owned loans: aligned Flex Modification framework (Guide chapters 9203–9206), the retention waterfall, Form 710 intake, and the 14-day modification recording SLA in 11 critical states (OH, AL, AR, CT, IA, MD, NE, NY, SD, HI, MA). Enforced in the LM Final Mod & Closing journey.
